answer: Exactly the owner decision listed under Open Ambiguities: A skip record docs in the path scanner, B edit the two quoted files, C report as informational with exit 0. Blocked until the owner picks.

Exactly the owner decision listed under Open Ambiguities: marker = frontmatter `record: true`, title containing 'archived', or `## Status` resolved/archived. Only the frontmatter option cleanly covers both files.

Verified: title is 'Handoff: 2026-09-10 session — uncommitted work and open items' (line 1, no 'archived'); its `## Status` body is 'resolved' plus 'open — nothing below is committed' (lines 7-12). Title-marker cannot cover it and the Status marker is self-contradictory. Drop the title option.

No keys required. Kind comes from the path glob (extract_docs.py:68-74); _metadata_from_mapping reads only id/title (extract_docs.py:161-168) and issue identity falls back to slug of the '# ' heading (extract_docs.py:192-193), so bare `record: true` frontmatter is safe and does not change identity.
Kind is assigned by directory in extract_docs.py:68-74: desk/tasks/*.md -> task, desk/drawer/issues/*.md -> issue. No frontmatter is needed; both named files are issues purely by path.

Already fixed by the task text: Scope says the marker is checked on every extracted document, not only under desk/drawer/, and Goal says one general rule with no per-file allowlist. Generic, not named-only.

Option A wording is split: Open Ambiguities says 'skip record documents in the path scanner', Implementation Path says the path scanner 'drops those edges there'. Fix: state whether A suppresses only source-file-reference edges/findings from record docs or all declarations from record docs.

The parenthetical already distinguishes A: 'tags each edge from a record document with `record: true` (option A instead drops those edges there)'. A drops, C tags; not contradictory, though rephrasing as separate branches would read better.

No non-matching form is defined, and the task's example fails: SOURCE_PATH_RE only requires a non-[\w/.-] neighbor (extract_edges.py:25-27), so backtick/angle wrapping still matches. Criterion should be 'no substring matching SOURCE_PATH_RE'.

Exit rule is explicit in Implementation Path: 'exits 1 iff at least one non-record finding exists', so exit 0 when only informational findings exist. Done When ('exits 0 ... may print informational record findings') matches.

Option C prescribes the 'Informational (archived records):' heading and 'N missing, M informational' tail, but no test asserts either; format compliance is unverifiable. Add a capsys assertion in tests/test_graph_cli.py or drop the format requirement.

Validation and Implementation Path cite tests/test_graph_cli.py and tests/test_graph_checks.py (cites test_graph_checks.py:25,64), but files: lists neither. Add both so the task bundle includes the files the changes must keep green.

Checked 2026-10-16, no drift: main.py:297-309 is the no-findings/print/return-1 block; extract_edges.py:93 is `if source_node.kind in {"task", "issue"}:`; test_graph_checks.py:25 and :64 are the to_dict assertions.

If new non-record findings appear, `graph missing --root .` cannot exit 0, so Done When fails; 'list them in the closeout' implies closure instead. State that such findings block Done When and must be captured/routed as new work.
Only 0 non-record findings is the acceptance condition (Done When: exit 0); an exact 99-informational count is not needed and would be brittle when the two files change.
